summary: This Form 6-K is a routine shareholder update from a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. Virax Biolabs Group Limited published a press release summarizing its fiscal 2026 annual report, subsequent financing (preferred investment option exercise for ~$3.3M), a commercial supply agreement with Fosun Diagnostics, and Nasdaq compliance regained after a 1-for-25 reverse stock split. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is described. Management provided an ordinary business update with no material corporate event triggering a special-situation classification.
